#!/bin/bash
# Managed by AMP - regenerated on every update and start.
# The bundled MongoDB: MongoDB 3.4 for Linux, run natively (no Wine), everything in database/:
#   database/mongodb/  binaries        database/data/  data (WiredTiger)        database/mongod.log
# 3.4 is the newest MongoDB the game's database driver works with (see the README).
#   install <version> <sha256>  update stage: downloads MongoDB's generic Linux build, unless that version is installed
#   prepare   start stage: stops a MongoDB left running, migrates old MongoDB 2.6 data once, restarts the Wine server
#   start     hub-wrapper.sh, before Hub: starts MongoDB and waits until it accepts connections
#   stop      hub-wrapper.sh, after Hub: shuts MongoDB down cleanly
#   external  start stage: waits for External MongoDB Hosts
ROOT='{{$FullRootDir}}'
DB="${ROOT}database"
BIN="$DB/mongodb/bin"
DATA="$DB/data"
PID="$DB/mongod.pid"
PORT='{{$MongoPort}}'
export WINEPREFIX="${ROOT}.wine" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES='mscoree,mshtml='
WINESERVER="$(dirname "$(readlink -f /usr/bin/wine)")/wineserver"

port_open() { (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$1") 2>/dev/null; }
free_port() { local p=$1; while port_open "$p"; do p=$((p + 1)); done; echo "$p"; }
running() { [ -s "$PID" ] && ps -p "$(cat "$PID")" -o args= 2>/dev/null | grep -q '[m]ongod '; }
wine_mongod_running() { ps -eo args | grep -q '^[^ ]*[m]ongod\.exe'; }
empty_data() { rm -rf "${DATA:?}" && mkdir -p "$DATA"; }

stop_mongod() {
  running || { rm -f "$PID"; return 0; }
  echo 'Stopping MongoDB'
  kill -TERM "$(cat "$PID")"
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do running || { rm -f "$PID"; return 0; }; sleep 1; done
  echo 'WARNING: MongoDB did not stop within 60s'
  return 1
}

start_mongod() {
  [ -x "$BIN/mongod" ] || { echo "MongoDB is not installed in $DB/mongodb: update the instance. Aborting"; return 1; }
  running && { echo 'MongoDB is already running'; return 0; }
  port_open "$PORT" && { echo "Port $PORT (MongoDB Port) is already in use by something else. Aborting"; return 1; }
  mkdir -p "$DATA"
  "$BIN/mongod" --dbpath "$DATA" --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB '{{MongoCacheSizeGB}}' \
    --logpath "$DB/mongod.log" --logappend --pidfilepath "$PID" --fork >/dev/null \
    || { tail -n 5 "$DB/mongod.log"; echo 'MongoDB did not start, see database/mongod.log. Aborting'; return 1; }
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do port_open "$PORT" && { echo "MongoDB is up on 127.0.0.1:$PORT"; return 0; }; sleep 1; done
  echo 'MongoDB did not accept connections within 60s, see database/mongod.log. Aborting'
  return 1
}

# Template versions before 2.0 ran the MongoDB 2.6 that ships with the server under Wine, with its data in
# server/mongo-data (before 1.12: mongo-data). That data is copied into database/data once, here: the old
# mongod.exe serves it on a spare port, and the 3.4 tools dump it into a temporary 3.4 on another one.
# database/data/.migrated records it. The old folder is left as it is.
migrate() {
  local old='' d
  for d in "${ROOT}server/mongo-data" "${ROOT}mongo-data"; do
    ls "$d"/*.ns >/dev/null 2>&1 && { old=$d; break; }
  done
  [ -n "$old" ] || return 0
  [ -e "$DATA/.migrated" ] && return 0
  if [ -n "$(ls -A "$DATA" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "Note: $old holds MongoDB 2.6 data that was not migrated, because database/data already has data"
    return 0
  fi
  [ -x "$BIN/mongod" ] || { echo "MongoDB is not installed in $DB/mongodb: update the instance. Aborting"; return 1; }
  local m26="${ROOT}server/cloud/mongodb"
  [ -f "$m26/mongod.exe" ] || { echo "$old needs MongoDB 2.6 to be read, but server/cloud/mongodb/mongod.exe is missing. Aborting"; return 1; }
  echo "Migrating the MongoDB 2.6 data in $old to MongoDB 3.4 in database/data (once; the old folder stays as it is)"
  # A non-empty lock with no journal files is left by a clean shutdown that was cut off after its final commit.
  if [ -s "$old/mongod.lock" ] && ! ls "$old"/journal/j._* >/dev/null 2>&1; then : > "$old/mongod.lock"; fi
  local src dst log="$DB/migrate.log" status dbs ok=1
  src=$(free_port 27100)
  (cd "$m26" && exec /usr/bin/wine mongod.exe --dbpath "Z:$old" --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port "$src" --smallfiles --logpath "Z:$old/mongod.log" --logappend) >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  for i in $(seq 1 90); do port_open "$src" && break; sleep 1; done
  if ! port_open "$src"; then
    echo "MongoDB 2.6 did not start on the old data, see $old/mongod.log. Aborting"
    "$WINESERVER" -k 2>/dev/null
    return 1
  fi
  dst=$(free_port $((src + 1)))
  mkdir -p "$DATA"
  : > "$log"
  if "$BIN/mongod" --dbpath "$DATA" --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port "$dst" --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB 0.25 --logpath "$DB/migrate-mongod.log" --fork >/dev/null; then
    # admin holds 2.6's users and auth schema, which the game doesn't use.
    "$BIN/mongodump" --host "127.0.0.1:$src" --archive 2>>"$log" | "$BIN/mongorestore" --host "127.0.0.1:$dst" --archive --nsExclude 'admin.*' 2>>"$log"
    status=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
    dbs=$("$BIN/mongo" --port "$dst" --quiet --eval 'db.adminCommand("listDatabases").databases.forEach(function (d) { if (d.name != "admin" && d.name != "local") print(d.name); })' 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')
    [ "${status[0]}" -eq 0 ] && [ "${status[1]}" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$dbs" ] && ok=0
    "$BIN/mongod" --dbpath "$DATA" --shutdown >/dev/null
  else
    echo 'Temporary MongoDB 3.4 did not start, see database/migrate-mongod.log' >>"$log"
  fi
  "$BIN/mongo" --port "$src" --quiet --eval "db.getSiblingDB('admin').shutdownServer()" >/dev/null 2>&1
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do wine_mongod_running || break; sleep 1; done
  if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then
    tail -n 20 "$log"
    echo 'Migrating the MongoDB data failed (full output in database/migrate.log). database/data was emptied again; the old data is untouched. Aborting'
    empty_data
    return 1
  fi
  echo "$old on $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC'): $dbs" > "$DATA/.migrated"
  echo "Migrated: $dbs"
  echo "Once the server runs fine, $old can be deleted"
}

case "$1" in
  install)
    version=$2 sha=$3
    mkdir -p "$DATA"
    if [ -x "$BIN/mongod" ] && "$BIN/mongod" --version | grep -q "^db version v$version\$"; then
      echo "MongoDB $version is already installed"; exit 0
    fi
    tgz="$DB/mongodb.tgz"
    echo "Downloading MongoDB $version"
    wget -nv -O "$tgz" "https://fastdl.mongodb.org/linux/mongodb-linux-x86_64-$version.tgz" || { rm -f "$tgz"; echo 'MongoDB download failed. Aborting'; exit 1; }
    echo "$sha  $tgz" | sha256sum -c --quiet - || { rm -f "$tgz"; echo 'MongoDB download has the wrong checksum. Aborting'; exit 1; }
    rm -rf "$DB/mongodb" && mkdir -p "$DB/mongodb" && tar -xzf "$tgz" -C "$DB/mongodb" --strip-components=1 || { rm -f "$tgz"; echo 'Extracting MongoDB failed. Aborting'; exit 1; }
    rm -f "$tgz"
    echo "MongoDB $version installed in database/mongodb"
    ;;
  prepare)
    # A MongoDB from a run whose hub-wrapper.sh was killed before it could stop it.
    stop_mongod || exit 1
    # The Wine MongoDB 2.6 of template versions before 2.0, which kept running after Hub stopped.
    if wine_mongod_running; then
      echo 'Stopping the old Wine MongoDB 2.6'
      [ -x "$BIN/mongo" ] && "$BIN/mongo" --port "$PORT" --quiet --eval "db.getSiblingDB('admin').shutdownServer()" >/dev/null 2>&1
      for i in $(seq 1 60); do wine_mongod_running || break; sleep 1; done
    fi
    if [ '{{MongoMode}}' != external ]; then migrate || exit 1; fi
    # Restarting the Wine server clears services and sockets left over from the last run.
    echo 'Restarting the Wine server'
    "$WINESERVER" -k 2>/dev/null
    "$WINESERVER" -w 2>/dev/null
    ;;
  start)
    start_mongod
    ;;
  stop)
    stop_mongod
    ;;
  external)
    # Waits until one host of the first host group in External MongoDB Hosts accepts connections.
    # Format (db_mongoHosts): host1[:port],host2[:port]|options;group2...
    HOSTS='{{MongoHosts}}'
    HOSTS=${HOSTS%%;*}; HOSTS=${HOSTS%%|*}
    [ -n "$HOSTS" ] || { echo 'External MongoDB Hosts is empty. Aborting'; exit 1; }
    IFS=, read -r -a LIST <<< "$HOSTS"
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      for h in "${LIST[@]}"; do
        h=${h// /}; host=${h%:*}; port=${h##*:}; [ "$port" = "$h" ] && port=27017
        if (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/$host/$port") 2>/dev/null; then echo "External MongoDB is up at $host:$port"; exit 0; fi
      done
      sleep 2
    done
    echo "External MongoDB ($HOSTS) did not accept connections within 60s. Aborting"
    exit 1
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 install <version> <sha256> | prepare | start | stop | external"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
